turns.prompt:
You are given one attached CSV file:
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

No property values are provided. Using your knowledge of crystal optics,
crystal symmetry and structure-property relationships, select 5 candidates
that jointly span the best trade-off between a LARGE SHG tensor component
|d_ij| and a WIDE band gap. Neither is given for the pool. Your 5 picks are
scored by the dominated hypervolume they span in the normalized (|d_ij|,
band gap) plane, so a set of mutually non-dominated candidates covering the
frontier beats 5 candidates that are all strong on the same single axis.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The SHG tensor vanishes by symmetry in any centrosymmetric crystal, so only acentric structure types can contribute. Inspection of the given lattices and Wyckoff positions identifies several families that are guaranteed acentric (zincblende/F-43m, wurtzite/P6\(_3\)mc, chalcopyrite/I-42d, defect-chalcopyrite/I-42m, and \(\beta\)-NaFeO\(_2\)/Pna2\(_1\)).

Within this acentric subset the usual inverse correlation between \(|d_{ij}|\) and \(E_g\) holds, but the correlation is not perfect: tetrahedral pnictides and certain defect chalcopyrites lie above the average trend. Consequently a non-dominated front is obtained by taking
- the most ionic zincblende (largest gap, modest \(d_{14}\)),
- a wurtzite-derived LiAlS\(_2\) analogue (still wide-gap, IR-transparent),
- a ZnGa\(_2\)S\(_4\) defect chalcopyrite (intermediate gap and \(d_{36}\)),
- an HgAl\(_2\)Se\(_4\) defect chalcopyrite (smaller gap, larger polarizability),
- CdSiP\(_2\) (classic chalcopyrite with exceptionally large \(d_{14}\) at still-usable gap).

These five points are mutually non-dominated and span the full range from the high-gap/low-\(d\) corner to the low-gap/high-\(d\) corner, thereby maximizing dominated hypervolume.

Final: c030, c082, c057, c037, c050
